entry.title: New: dsh-prompt-polish
entry.summary: One-click ✨ polish button for the composer: rewrites prompts and drafts with WorkBuddy humanizer-style rules (kills AI-flavored phrasing, varies rhythm, mode-aware for instructions/questions/prose) via free Zhipu GLM-4.5-Flash or any OpenAI-compatible API, falling back to offline local rules.
